issue_request: FHIR-20583 was Published/Persuasive and requested guidance/examples for element-level Provenance in two places: Provenance.target and Provenance.entity.what, using the targetElement/targetPath extensions from GF#21284.
initial_application: FHIR-21284 added the targetElement and targetPath Reference extensions, b84bf92092 added Provenance target examples, and 6e01cea5c6f added target-level Provenance narrative. Current source still lacked an example placing the extension on Provenance.entity.what.
additional_context: FHIR-23076 covers the target-level Provenance narrative already present in source. The Extension Pack definitions declare targetElement/targetPath context as Reference, so using targetPath on Provenance.entity.what is in scope. Zulip discussion in 2021 confirmed the then-new examples covered only the first FHIR-20583 use case and that the second should use the same extension pattern in .entity.
reconciliation: Added source/provenance/provenance-example7.xml showing Procedure/example derived from Claim/100150 line item via targetPath on Provenance.entity.what, registered it in list-Provenance-examples.xml, and updated provenance-notes.xml to point readers to the new example.
